items.title: History Has An Opinion On This CCL Price Level
items.summary: Carnival Corporation (CCL), the global cruise line operator, has pulled back about 14% from its early-August high near $29.67, settling near $25.37 a share after Wednesday's sector-wide selloff on rising fuel costs. That's a separate, steeper retreat from the stock's 52-week high of $34.03, set earlier this year.

items.title: Why Norwegian Cruise Line (NCLH) Shares Are Sliding Today
items.summary: Shares of cruise company Norwegian Cruise Line (NYSE:NCLH) fell 5% in the afternoon session after rising crude oil prices raised concerns about higher operating costs across the cruise industry. Fuel is a major expense for operators, and higher oil prices can squeeze margins when ticket prices and itineraries are largely set months ahead.
